correction_summary.diagnosis_root_cause: Vite/Vitest 4.1.10 module runner resolves `import { z } from "zod"` against the package's `"main"` CJS entry (`node_modules/.bun/zod@4.6.5/node_modules/zod/index.cjs`), leaving the destructured `z.custom`, `z.object`, etc. undefined under ESM-style destructuring. This affected EVERY test that transitively pulled real SDK source code into the test process: (a) the bridge config tests via `@cline-internal/core/...` aliases to `sdk/packages/core/src/...`; (b) the base config tests via `cline-core-vitest-stub.ts` → `createFileReadExecutor` → `schemas.ts` → `import { z } from "zod"`. The bridge config already had setupFiles omitted so the chain was reachable only via the test imports; the base config ran it during setupFiles. Both failed with `TypeError: undefined is not an object (evaluating 'z.custom' / 'z.object')` at module-load time.
correction_summary.fix: Add `optimizeDeps.include: ["zod"], force: true` + `ssr.noExternal: ["zod"]` at the TOP LEVEL of both `vitest.config.ts` and `vitest.config.c2-4-c-bridge.ts`. The `optimizeDeps` pre-bundle causes Vite to compile zod into `node_modules/.vite/deps/zod.js` from its ESM `import` entry (`index.js` → `export { z, z as default } from "./v4/classic/external.js"`); the `ssr.noExternal` ensures the SSR runtime used by `vitest run` picks the pre-bundled ESM shape. CRITICAL: these blocks must be at the TOP LEVEL of the config (siblings of `test:`, `resolve:`, etc.), not inside `test:` — the bridge config already had this correct; my first attempt on the base config put them inside `test:` and they were silently ignored.
